title: Grade 3 French — Wed, Jun 11
description: La famille — Day 3 of 5: Extended family members
subject: french

questions.question: How do you say 'an uncle' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un oncle' = an uncle. 'Mon oncle s'appelle Rajan.' = My uncle is called Rajan.

questions.question: How do you say 'an aunt' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Une tante' = an aunt. 'Ma tante est gentille.' = My aunt is kind.

questions.question: What is 'un cousin' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Un cousin' = a male cousin. 'Une cousine' = a female cousin. 'Mon cousin joue au cricket.' = My cousin plays cricket.

questions.question: How do you say 'a grandfather' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un grand-père' = a grandfather. 'Mon grand-père raconte des histoires.' = My grandfather tells stories.

questions.question: How do you say 'a grandmother' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Une grand-mère' = a grandmother. 'Ma grand-mère fait de bons repas.' = My grandmother makes good meals.

questions.question: What is 'un neveu' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Un neveu' = a nephew. 'Une nièce' = a niece. 'Mon neveu a cinq ans.' = My nephew is five years old.

questions.question: What is 'les grands-parents' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Les grands-parents' = the grandparents (grand-père + grand-mère together). 'J'aime mes grands-parents.' = I love my grandparents.

questions.question: Your father's brother is your ___.
questions.explanation: Your father's or mother's brother = 'oncle' (uncle). 'L'oncle est le frère de mon père ou de ma mère.'

questions.question: How do you say 'my grandparents' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Mes grands-parents' = my grandparents. 'Mes' is the plural possessive for 'my'.

questions.question: Complete: 'La sœur de mon père est ma ___.'
questions.explanation: La sœur de ton père = ta tante (your aunt). 'La sœur de mon père est ma tante.'

questions.question: How do you say 'I have a big family' in French?
questions.explanation: 'J'ai une grande famille.' = I have a big family. 'Grand(e)' = big/large. 'J'ai' = I have.

questions.question: Your aunt's son is your ___.
questions.explanation: Your aunt's or uncle's son = your cousin. 'Le fils de ma tante est mon cousin.'

questions.question: Translate: 'My grandparents live in Lucknow.'
questions.explanation: 'Mes grands-parents vivent à Lucknow.' = My grandparents live in Lucknow. 'Vivent' = live (ils/elles form of vivre).

questions.question: What does 'la famille étendue' mean?
options: The extended family (includes grandparents, uncles, aunts, cousins)
questions.explanation: 'La famille étendue' = the extended family — grandparents, uncles, aunts, cousins, nieces, nephews. Goes beyond just parents and siblings.

questions.question: In French, how do you say 'Happy Grandparents' Day!'?
questions.explanation: 'Bonne fête des grands-parents!' = Happy Grandparents' Day! 'Fête' = celebration/day. Grandparents' Day is celebrated in France in late October.
